headline: Puebla Exceeded Forecasts by Over 30% in Sales During El Buen Fin 2026
summary: Puebla's shopping centres reported sales above the 30% forecast during El Buen Fin 2026. Footfall reached 80% to 90%, according to the Puebla Shopping Centre Association.
why: El Buen Fin is Mexico's annual discount shopping event, and its results indicate consumer spending strength ahead of the year-end season.
original_headline: Puebla cumplió con pronósticos por arriba del 30% en ventas durante El Buen Fin 2026
